name: Manliness
overview: Scripture portrays manliness as strength coupled with courage, grounded in the assurance of God's presence, as seen in Joshua's call to be strong and unafraid. It also involves self-discipline and moral integrity, exemplified by the admonition to have rule over one's spirit and avoid ungodly influences. Manliness includes readiness and responsibility, symbolized by girding up the loins like a man to face challenges, and it flourishes through mutual encouragement and sharpening among friends.
